integrity: The construction is exact on a one-dimensional smooth strongly convex quadratic. Every selected approximate minimizer is checked directly against the source tolerance inequality, and the two Wolfe inequalities are reduced to exact rational/algebraic branch conditions.
scientific_limitations: The counterexample targets well-definedness of the Wolfe-type line search under the paper's stated arbitrary approximate-minimizer model. It does not rule out existence under a continuous inner-solver selection or a repaired line-search/oracle coupling.
title: An explicit empty-Wolfe-step example for an admissible inexact Moreau oracle
